desc:
🚗 Can you pass your driving test without scaring the examiner?

🎫 Take a number and wait your turn at the DMV
📝 Pass the eye test and the written test
🛣️ Drive the city with a strict examiner

🚦 Stop signs, red lights, signals and speed limits
🦆 Ducks, ambulances and a runaway ball on the road
🪞 First-person driving with working mirrors
🏆 11 endings, from Honor Roll to Fountain Splash
🪪 Earn your Car License, then your Truck License
🏎️ Unlock 9 cars and paint them in your garage
📱 Play on phone, PC and console
